item.title: Forum Criticism Team - Captain Post
item.content:encoded:
Author, per the required reading forum guidelines: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282684/required-reading:how-to-use-this-forum-ideas please fill out the concept template to seek feedback on your idea.

item.title: SCP idea: punk rock jesus
item.content:encoded:
Punk rock jesus manifests next to the beds of children from christian households whose parents believe they've sinned
His appearence is exactly that of biblical Character of Jesus Christ, although his hair has been replaced with a large, black-and-purple dyed mohawk, and his beard has also been dyed the same color. He also carries a large electric guitar shaped like a cross.
Once materializing, he'll sing a song to the child about their sins and the punishments satan has waiting for them.
Once his song is finished, punk rock jesus will hug the child and remind them to pray every night before bed and "stay rad"
